# Preparation

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

source(file = "helper_functions.R")

install_and_load(c("broom",
                   "broom.mixed",
                   "janitor",
                   "lme4",
                   "lmerTest",
                   "gridExtra",
                   "ggthemes",
                   "modelsummary",
                   "gt",
                   "officer",
                   "tidyverse")
                 )

df_triage <- 
  read_csv2(file = "data/triage_2023.csv") %>% 
  mutate(ID = 1:length(.$CASE))

if (file.exists("data/df_conj.R")) {
  
  df_conj <- dget(file = "data/df_conj.R")
  
} else {
  
  df_conj <- 
  df_triage %>% 
  filter(!is.na(IV01_01)) %>% 
  conj()

  dput(x = df_conj,
       file = "data/df_conj.R")
  
}

cache <- 
  df_triage %>% 
  select(ID, EX01:EX10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("EX"),
               values_to = "Choice",
               names_to = "vig_set") %>% 
  mutate(vig_set = str_replace(vig_set, "^[A-Za-z]+0*", ""),
         vig_set = as.numeric(vig_set)) %>% 
  add_case(ID = rep(unique(.$ID),
                    each = 10),
           Choice = NA,
           vig_set = rep(1:10, 
                         times = length(unique(.$ID))
                         )
           ) %>% 
  arrange(ID, vig_set) %>% 
  mutate(vig_profile = rep(1:2,
                           times = length(unique(.$ID)) * 10
                           )
         ) %>% 
  group_by(ID, vig_set) %>% 
  fill(Choice) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(vig_choice = case_when(Choice == vig_profile ~ 1,
                                Choice == 3 ~ 3,
                                Choice != vig_profile ~ 0)) %>% 
  select(!Choice)

df_triage_clean <- 
  left_join(x = cache,
            y = df_conj) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = !contains("vig_"),
                .fns = as_factor
                )
         ) %>% 
  rename_with(.cols = !matches('vig_|id'),
              ~ paste0("vig_", .x)
              )

df_triage_further <- 
  df_triage %>%
  transmute(id = as_factor(ID),
            consent = if_else(condition = PR04 == 1,
                              true = T,
                              false = F
                              ),
            bot_1 = if_else(condition = BF01 == 4,
                            true = T,
                            false = F
                            ),
            bot_2 = if_else(condition = BF04 == 4,
                            true = T,
                            false = F
                            ),
            bot_3 = if_else(condition = BF03 == 6,
                            true = T,
                            false = F
                            ),
            bot_all = if_else(condition = (is.na(bot_1) | is.na(bot_2) | is.na(bot_3)) | !bot_3,
                              true = F,
                              false = T
                              ),
            vacc_nr = FU09_01,
            vacc = if_else(condition = FU09_01 > 0,
                           true = T,
                           false = F),
            gender = factor(SD03,
                            levels = 1:3,
                            labels = c("female",
                                       "male",
                                       "diverse")
                            ),
            year = SD04_01,
            month = SD05,
            age = if_else(month < 8,
                          true = 2023 - year,
                          false = (2023 - year) - 1),
            educ = SD06_01,
            time = as.numeric(df_triage$LASTDATA - df_triage$STARTED),
            time = time/60
            ) 
  
df_triage_cache <- 
  df_triage_clean %>% 
  left_join(df_triage_further,
            by = "id")

df_triage_final <- 
  df_triage_cache %>% 
    mutate(vig_age = factor(vig_age,
                          levels = c("25 years old","50 years old","75 years old")
                          ),
         vig_children = factor(vig_children,
                          levels = c("Has no children","Has children")
                          ),
         vig_chance_of_survival_with_ventilation = factor(vig_chance_of_survival_with_ventilation,
                          levels = c("20% chance of survival","50% chance of survival","80% chance of survival")
                          ),
         vig_ventilation_status = factor(vig_ventilation_status,
                          levels = c("Not ventilated yet","Is already ventilated")
                          ),
         vig_disability = factor(vig_disability,
                          levels = c("Has no disability","Has a disability")
                          ),
         vig_volunteer_work = factor(vig_volunteer_work,
                          levels = c("Does not volunteer work","Does volunteer work")
                          ),
         vig_vaccination_status = factor(vig_vaccination_status,
                          levels = c("Is not vaccinated","Is vaccinated")
                          ),
         vig_weight = factor(vig_weight,
                          levels = c("Not overweight","Overweight")
                          ),
         vacc = factor(
      vacc,
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    vacc_nr = vacc_nr
    )

rm(list=setdiff(ls(), "df_triage_final"))
```

# Sample

```{r}
#| label: sample

df_sample <-
  df_triage_final %>%
  select("id", "bot_all", "time", "vacc", "gender", "age", "educ", "vacc_nr") %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(
    time = if_else(time >= 5,
      true = TRUE,
      false = FALSE
    ),
    vacc = vacc,
    vacc_na = if_else(is.na(vacc),
      true = FALSE,
      false = TRUE
    ),
    all_exclusion = if_else(!bot_all | !time | !vacc_na,
      true = TRUE,
      false = FALSE
    )
  )

character_gender <-
  df_sample %>%
  filter(!all_exclusion) %>%
  mutate(
    attr = factor(gender,
      levels = c(
        "Gender",
        "male",
        "female",
        "diverse",
        "missing"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Gender",
        "Male",
        "Female",
        "Diverse",
        "Missing"
      )
    ),
    attr = replace_na(attr, "Missing")
  ) %>%
  count(attr) %>%
  mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
  add_case(
    attr = "Gender",
    n = NA,
    prop = NA,
    .before = 1
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = everything(), as.character))

character_age <-
  df_sample %>%
  filter(!all_exclusion) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = round(mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd = round(sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(age))
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    attr = "Age",
    n = paste0(mean, " (", sd, ")"),
    prop = ""
  ) %>%
  add_case(
    attr = "Missing",
    n = as.character(nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion & is.na(age)))),
    prop = as.character(round(nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion & is.na(age))) / (nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion))) * 100, 1))
  )

character_educ <-
  df_sample %>%
  filter(!all_exclusion) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = round(mean(educ, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    sd = round(sd(educ, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(educ))
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    attr = "Education (years)",
    n = paste0(mean, " (", sd, ")"),
    prop = ""
  ) %>%
  add_case(
    attr = "Missing",
    n = as.character(nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion & is.na(educ)))),
    prop = as.character(round(nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion & is.na(educ))) / (nrow(filter(df_sample, !all_exclusion))) * 100, 1))
  )

bind_rows(character_gender, character_age, character_educ) %>%
  rename(
    `Baseline characteristic` = attr,
    `Frequency or mean (SD)` = n,
    `Relative frequency in %` = prop
  )
```

# Decriptives -Figure 1

```{r}
#| label: fig1

fig_1a <-
  df_triage_final %>%
  filter(
    vig_set <= 5,
    time >= 5,
    bot_all,
    !is.na(vacc)
  ) %>%
  mutate(vacc = factor(vacc,
    levels = c("No", "Yes"),
    labels = c("Unvaccinated", "Vaccinated")
  )) %>%
  select("id", "vacc") %>%
  unique() %>%
  count(vacc) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    prop_text = paste0(round(prop, 3) * 100, "%")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(
    x = vacc,
    y = prop
  )) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "darkgrey",
    fill = "darkgrey"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    mapping = aes(
      label = prop_text,
      y = prop + 0.03
    ),
    family = "serif",
    color = "black",
    size = 9 / .pt
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "A)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "serif",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig_1b <-
  df_triage_final %>%
  filter(
    vig_set <= 5,
    time >= 5,
    bot_all,
    !is.na(vacc)
  ) %>%
  select("id", "vacc_nr") %>%
  unique() %>%
  count(vacc_nr) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    prop_text = paste0(round(prop, 3) * 100, "%")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(
    x = vacc_nr,
    y = prop
  )) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity",
    color = "darkgrey",
    fill = "darkgrey"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    mapping = aes(
      label = prop_text,
      y = prop + 0.01
    ),
    family = "serif",
    color = "black",
    size = 9 / .pt
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6) +
  labs(title = "B)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "serif",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

gridExtra::grid.arrange(fig_1a, fig_1b, ncol = 2)
```

# Models

## Figure 2

```{r}
#| label: fig2

df_triage_final %>%
  filter(
    vig_set <= 5,
    time >= 5,
    bot_all,
    !is.na(vacc)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vacc = factor(vacc,
      levels = c("No", "Yes"),
      labels = c("Unvaccinated", "Vaccinated")
    ),
    vig_vaccination_status = factor(vig_vaccination_status,
      levels = c("Is not vaccinated", "Is vaccinated"),
      labels = c("Unvaccinated", "Vaccinated")
    )
  ) %>%
  split(.$vacc) %>%
  map(~
    lmer(
      formula = vig_choice ~ vig_chance_of_survival_with_ventilation +
        vig_age +
        vig_weight +
        vig_ventilation_status +
        vig_children +
        vig_disability +
        vig_volunteer_work +
        vig_vaccination_status +
        (1 | id),
      data = .
    ) %>%
      marginal_means_all(.)) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "group") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    x = factor(x,
      levels = c(
        "20% chance of survival",
        "50% chance of survival",
        "80% chance of survival",
        "25 years old",
        "50 years old",
        "75 years old",
        "Has no disability",
        "Has a disability",
        "Not overweight",
        "Overweight",
        "Not ventilated yet",
        "Is already ventilated",
        "Does not volunteer work",
        "Does volunteer work",
        "Has no children",
        "Has children",
        "Unvaccinated",
        "Vaccinated"
      )
    ),
    x = fct_rev(x)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(
    x = predicted,
    y = x,
    xmin = conf.low,
    xmax = conf.high,
    color = group
  )) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0.5,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgrey", "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.3, 0.7, by = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Average marginal means",
    y = "",
    color = "Participant vaccination status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "serif",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black")
  )
```

## Figure 3

```{r}
#| label: fig3
#| message: false
#| warning: false

df_triage_final %>%
  filter(
    vig_set <= 5,
    time >= 5, bot_all,
    !is.na(vacc)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    vacc = factor(vacc,
      levels = c("No", "Yes"),
      labels = c("Unvaccinated", "Vaccinated")
    ),
    vig_vaccinated = factor(vig_vaccination_status,
      levels = c("Is not vaccinated", "Is vaccinated"),
      labels = c("Unvaccinated", "Vaccinated")
    ),
    vig_unvaccinated = fct_rev(vig_vaccinated),
    vig_x = case_when(vig_vaccinated == "Vaccinated" & vacc == "Vaccinated" ~ "Ingroup",
      vig_unvaccinated == "Unvaccinated" & vacc == "Unvaccinated" ~ "Ingroup",
      .default = "Outgroup"
    ),
    vig_x = factor(vig_x,
      levels = c("Outgroup", "Ingroup")
    )
  ) %>%
  lmer(
    formula = vig_choice ~ vig_chance_of_survival_with_ventilation +
      vig_age +
      vig_weight +
      vig_ventilation_status +
      vig_children +
      vig_disability +
      vig_volunteer_work +
      vig_x * vacc +
      (1 | id),
    data = .
  ) %>%
  ggeffects::predict_response(
    margin = "empirical",
    terms = c("vig_x", "vacc")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(mapping = aes(
    x = group,
    y = predicted,
    color = x,
    group = x,
    ymin = conf.low,
    ymax = conf.high
  )) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  geom_line(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.2),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "darkgrey", "black")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkgrey", "black")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.4, 0.6, by = 0.01)) +
  labs(
    x = "Participant vaccination status",
    y = "Average predicted probabilties",
    color = "Patient vaccination status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "serif",
      size = 12
    ),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.5),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```
